verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs say only InstantSearch.js, its front-end UI library, is open source, and a former customer says they left Algolia partly over its closed-source license. A user can read some client-side source, but not the hosted search engine that is the core product. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core search engine/service, a stated license for the core product, documentation of which repos are openly licensed beyond InstantSearch.
